Second, the required credit is exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' not the studio's standard music credit. I haven't entered these terms into the delivery tracker yet because the rights database migration is still open, but these are the authoritative terms from the countersigned license.

I've had the ingest test result sitting in the post-production test folder pending this routine package-lock meeting.
